# Mint

> Mint is a practice optimization partner for independent medical practices. Mint evaluates how a practice runs, delivers a playbook of optimization opportunities, then executes on it with the practice team. Mint is not a management services organization (MSO) and takes no ownership in client practices.

Mint works across three pillars: operations, revenue opportunities and marketing. Every engagement starts with discovery, a flat $1,500 evaluation that produces a current state map and an optimization opportunities map. The fee rolls into the first month if the practice signs on. Mint is starting with podiatry practices.
